items.docs: Get the messages in the signed-in user's mailbox (including Deleted Items and Clutter folders). Depending on the page size and mailbox data, getting messages may incur multiple requests. The default page size is 10. Requires Mail.ReadBasic, Mail.Read, or Mail.ReadWrite permission.
Create a draft of a new message in the signed-in user's mailbox. The draft can then be updated and sent. The message is saved in the Drafts folder by default. Requires Mail.ReadWrite permission.
